example-embed.name: Example Embed
example-embed.description: Minimal embed preset: 3D only, source panels hidden, Image Georeferencer hidden, hillshade + hypsometric tint on by default.

mapterhorn-globe.name: Mapterhorn Globe
mapterhorn-globe.description: Minimal globe view zoomed out to the whole world, Mapterhorn as the only terrain source, source pickers and Image Georeferencer hidden, GMT Globe hypsometric ramp.

dura.name: Dura Frescoes Viewer
dura.description: Dura Europos Synagogue COG terrain + basemap (W-0.5mm), fixed 2D view over the site, hillshade on (hypsometric tint off), raster basemap at 90% opacity, Relief Visualization and Terrain Analysis available but off, contours/mound-detector/split-screen/elevation-picker off and hidden, 2D/3D view modes only (no globe), sidebar closed by default, source pickers hidden, Visualization Modes and Hillshade Options sections open, map controls disabled, Bookmarks/Source-Info/Sun-Shadow-Calculator/Image-Georeferencer sections and the General Settings Project + Open-in controls hidden, light pinned to Free mode (no Free/Datetime selector), Shadows sub-mode off and hidden.

dura-walls.name: Dura Frescoes Viewer, Four Walls
dura-walls.description: Dura Europos Synagogue COG terrain + basemap (the four walls side by side in one 2 mm mosaic, GRID-2mm), fixed 2D view over the four walls, hillshade on (hypsometric tint off), raster basemap at 90% opacity, Relief Visualization and Terrain Analysis available but off, contours/mound-detector/split-screen/elevation-picker off and hidden, 2D/3D view modes only (no globe), sidebar closed by default, source pickers hidden, Visualization Modes and Hillshade Options sections open, map controls disabled, Bookmarks/Source-Info/Sun-Shadow-Calculator/Image-Georeferencer sections and the General Settings Project + Open-in controls hidden, light pinned to Free mode (no Free/Datetime selector), Shadows sub-mode off and hidden.

maya-lidar.name: Maya Lowlands Lidar
maya-lidar.description: Tikal, Holmul, La Corona (PACUNAM Lidar Initiative, 1 m) and Chactun (0.5 m): the sky view factor, local dominance and 16-direction hillshade renders of each, all twelve loaded at once as overlays (sky view factor on top; reorder or hide them in the Overlays list). Opens over Tikal at zoom 14; the renders show from zoom 11 or 12 (Chactun's sky view factor from 15). Renders by the Middle American Research Institute GIS Lab (MARI-GISLAB) at Tulane University, Estrada-Belli et al. 2023, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see Estrada-Belli, Canuto, Šprajc and Fernandez-Diaz (2025), Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports, doi:10.1016/j.jasrep.2025.105288.
